notes.title: Builder Simulator is coming on 09/06/2022!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Renovators![/b][/h1]

[h2]It’s time for a big announcement from our company! 👷👷‍♀️ We've got the date – 🦺 [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120320/]Builder Simulator[/url][/b] is coming out on June 9th! The release price is 19,99 USD.

And there is more! We've prepared something special for you: [b]interiors[/b]! Now you will be truly able to create the house of your dreams and turn that house into a home (sweet home)❗️

We have to add, that the effect will be stunning! Wanna bet? You can see a little sneak peek of the Builder Simulator interiors here: [/h2][previewyoutube=hluqfpQ-CrI;full][/previewyoutube]

Can't wait to see your first buildings! 🏡

And stay tuned – there’s still much more to come!🤖🦾 

Best regards,
Train Station Renovation Team

notes.title: Quick Update 1.0.0.2p
notes.content:
[h1]Hello train fans[/h1]

We love your commitment and how are you reacting on [b]Train Station Renovation - First Job! [/b]You are giving us a lot of feedback and what is more importantly - you are reporting bugs! A lot of them! What we are doing with reported bugs? We fix them, naturally! 

Today we are planning to release a new version of the game - [b] 1.0.0.2p [/b] will contain fixes and adjustments. Here are most important changes and fixes:

The most reported bug is about a problem with launching a game - we believe we fix this one - but as always - we are counting you will confirm this by downloading update with fixes!

We also made some optimizations and fixed other reported bugs! Or more accurate is to say that we believe so! Now our game should perform better! 

We also make some tweaks and adjustments here and there so the game should be better balanced and fair! For example broom  and how much it is cleaning at one sweep!

Thank you for positive energy, enjoying our game and ongoing bug reports! 
We hope that on 30th April we will release bug free game, thanks to you and your effort! 

[b]Quick List:
-Game Crashes - fixed
-Broom - Improved swept 
-Further optimization[/b]


[i][b]If there are more bugs, please keep us informed! We are doing all we can in order to give you the best game ever![/b][/i]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/914010/discussions/0/1606022547924089640/


Best Regards,
Train Station Renovation Team
